recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-20179. If desired, clean the duplicated "as" through a separate editorial pass rather than treating this Applied/Published issue as not implemented.
issue_request: FHIR-20179 was Published with Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked to resolve confusion caused by mentioning OD/OS when the required vision-eye-codes value set contains only the FHIR right/left codes, and to correct the misspelling of oculus sinister.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed source commit was found. Git history shows commit a86020d78d769d63c73b763fa178571cd4703ff1 changed the VisionPrescription.lensSpecification.eye comment from the old OD/OS wording with "oculus siniter" to the resolved paper-claim/medical-record alias wording with "oculus sinister".
additional_context: VisionPrescription is active in source/fhir.ini, so the inspected StructureDefinition and local terminology are current build inputs. The CodeSystem/ValueSet still contain only right and left, while the element comment explains OD/OS as external aliases. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community or work-group evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already carries the accepted clarification and spelling fix; the duplicated word "as" in the applied resolution/source is editorial and does not change implementer understanding of the required right/left binding or the OD/OS alias note.
